zh.title: Git 期望状态 vs 集群状态
zh.question: autoSync、selfHeal、prune 各自改变什么？同步状态和健康状态是同一件事吗？
zh.assumption: 用整数简化副本数与版本号；模型只比较 replicas/version/resource 三个字段。健康状态独立供给，任何开关都不会制造健康恢复。历史回滚只建模存活且仍由 Git 定义的工作负载；示例资源只是应用中多个资源之一，allowEmpty 不在范围内。语义对照官方 auto sync 与 sync options 文档，不是 Argo CD 本体。
zh.observe: 观察：哪个开关让差异消失？删除真的发生了吗？健康状态动了吗？
zh.footerNote: 示意模型 · 规则假设 · 对应来源
zh.traceNotice: 教学简化模型 · 非 Argo CD 本体

guardReasons.auto-sync: 自动同步已启用时无法历史回滚
guardReasons.no-history: 该场景没有可恢复的部署历史
guardReasons.no-live-workload: 本教学模型只回滚存活且仍由 Git 定义的工作负载

explanations.rollback-blocked: 自动同步已启用：Argo CD 直接拒绝历史回滚，先关掉 autoSync。
explanations.rollback-temporary: 历史回滚动了集群，但 Git 期望没变：下一次调和或手动同步会把版本拉回来，持久恢复要走 Git revert。
explanations.deletion-pruned: prune 开启：Git 删除的资源被显式删除。
explanations.deletion-kept: prune 关闭：Git 删除的资源连同它的副本与版本原样留在集群，差异会一直挂着这个待删除项。
explanations.self-healed: selfHeal 生效：集群内的手工改动被同步回 Git 期望状态。
explanations.auto-synced: 自动同步生效：Git 的新期望状态已经应用。
explanations.drift-kept: 只有 autoSync：集群漂移不会被自动修复——selfHeal 是另一个开关。
explanations.idle: 没有自动化动作：差异在等待手动同步。

en.title: Git desired state vs cluster state
en.question: What do autoSync, selfHeal and prune each change — and is Sync status the same thing as Health?
en.assumption: Replicas and versions are simplified integers; exactly three fields are compared. Health is supplied independently — no toggle fabricates health recovery. History rollback covers only a live, Git-defined workload, and the illustrated resource is one of several (allowEmpty out of scope). Semantics follow the official auto sync and sync options docs — not Argo CD itself.
en.observe: Observe: which toggle removes the delta? Did the deletion actually happen? Did health move at all?
en.traceNotice: Teaching model — not Argo CD itself

guardReasons.auto-sync: Unavailable while automated sync is enabled
guardReasons.no-history: No deployment history entry in this scenario
guardReasons.no-live-workload: This limited teaching model only rolls back a live, Git-defined workload

explanations.rollback-blocked: Automated sync is enabled: Argo CD refuses history rollback — turn autoSync off first.
explanations.rollback-temporary: History rollback moved the cluster, but Git still names the newer version: the next reconcile or a manual sync pulls it back — durable recovery goes through Git revert.
explanations.deletion-pruned: prune is on: the Git-deleted resource was explicitly deleted.
explanations.deletion-kept: prune is off: the Git-deleted resource stays in the cluster exactly as it runs (replicas and version untouched) and the delta keeps showing the pending deletion.
explanations.self-healed: selfHeal applied: the cluster-side change was reverted to Git's desired state.
explanations.auto-synced: Automated sync applied the new desired state from Git.
explanations.drift-kept: autoSync alone: cluster drift is not reverted — selfHeal is a separate switch.
explanations.synced-clean: Git and the cluster agree: Synced.
explanations.idle: No automation: the delta waits for a manual sync.
